# Draft:Logistics of the 1896 Republican and Populist National Conventions

Ahead of the 1896 United States presidential election, the Republican and the Populist parties both held their presidential nominating conventions at the same venue in St. Louis, with Republicans holding their convention in June and Populists holding their convention in July. The Populist Party was a short-lived third major party in United States politics.
